```js
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const records = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('./records.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));

const LIMIT_MIN = 1;
const LIMIT_MAX = 3;

const inputSchema = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: LIMIT_MIN, maximum: LIMIT_MAX },
    cursor: { type: 'string' }
  },
  required: ['limit'],
  additionalProperties: false
};

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'audit_page',
      description: 'Paginate audit records with an opaque cursor.',
      inputSchema
    }
  ];
}

function invalidParams(message) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.code = -32602;
  return e;
}

function parseCursor(cursor, total) {
  // returns offset
  if (typeof cursor !== 'string') throw invalidParams('cursor must be a string');
  if (!/^c[0-9]+$/.test(cursor)) throw invalidParams('malformed cursor');
  const offset = Number(cursor.slice(1));
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0) throw invalidParams('malformed cursor');
  if (offset >= total) throw invalidParams('unknown cursor');
  return offset;
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'audit_page') {
    const e = new Error('unknown tool: ' + name);
    e.code = -32601;
    throw e;
  }
  // validate extra fields
  const allowed = new Set(['limit', 'cursor']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) throw invalidParams('unexpected field: ' + key);
  }
  // validate limit
  const { limit, cursor } = args;
  if (limit === undefined || limit === null) throw invalidParams('limit is required');
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit)) throw invalidParams('limit must be an integer');
  if (limit < LIMIT_MIN || limit > LIMIT_MAX) throw invalidParams('limit must be between 1 and 3');
  // determine offset
  let offset = 0;
  if (cursor !== undefined && cursor !== null) {
    offset = parseCursor(cursor, records.length);
  }
  const slice = records.slice(offset, offset + limit);
  const nextOffset = offset + limit;
  const next_cursor = nextOffset < records.length ? 'c' + nextOffset : null;
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ records: slice, next_cursor }) }]
  };
}
```
